title: Tráfego por grupo de ASN/CDN
description: Banda por grupo de ASN/CDN (Google, Meta, Netflix, caches...). Grupos editáveis no painel web. Pares de IP das últimas 24 h.

panels.title: Banda por grupo
panels.description: Taxa de cada grupo ao longo do tempo (só os grupos cadastrados; o resto fica em 'Outros' na tabela). Recebido = download dos clientes.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p.bucket_utc,'5m'),COALESCE((SELECT np.name FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind='group' AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end ORDER BY np.v_end-np.v_start LIMIT 1),g.name,'Outros') AS metric,SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/300 AS value FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn=p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind IN ('protected','private','infra') AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end) GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING metric<>'Outros' ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT np.name FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind='group' AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end ORDER BY np.v_end-np.v_start LIMIT 1),g.name,'Outros') AS grupo,SUM(p.total_bytes) AS volume FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn=p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind IN ('protected','private','infra') AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE((SELECT np.name FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind='group' AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end ORDER BY np.v_end-np.v_start LIMIT 1),g.name,'Outros') AS 'Grupo',SUM(p.total_bytes) AS 'Volume',SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS 'Taxa média',ROUND(100*SUM(p.total_bytes)/GREATEST(1,SUM(SUM(p.total_bytes)) OVER ()),1) AS '% do total',COUNT(DISTINCT p.${lado}_ip) AS 'IPs remotos' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn=p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind IN ('protected','private','infra') AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Maiores ASNs fora dos grupos ('Outros')
panels.description: Candidatos a virar grupo: cadastre no painel web (Monitoramento > Grupos de ASN). Caches de CDN dentro do transito entram por bloco IP.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.${lado}_asn AS 'ASN',MAX(NULLIF(p.${lado}_asn_name,'')) AS 'Nome',SUM(p.total_bytes) AS 'Volume',SUM(p.total_bytes)*8/GREATEST(1,$__unixEpochTo()-$__unixEpochFrom()) AS 'Taxa média',COUNT(DISTINCT p.${lado}_ip) AS 'IPs remotos' FROM orby_ip_pairs_minute p LEFT JOIN orby_asn_group_members g ON g.asn=p.${lado}_asn WHERE p.source='huawei' AND $__timeFilter(p.bucket_utc) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind IN ('protected','private','infra') AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end) AND COALESCE((SELECT np.name FROM orby_net_prefixes np WHERE np.kind='group' AND INET_ATON(p.${lado}_ip) BETWEEN np.v_start AND np.v_end ORDER BY np.v_end-np.v_start LIMIT 1),g.name,'Outros')='Outros' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 30
